references.text: Jesus admires the faith of another person, which shows the importance of faith in miracles.
Jesus recognizes and rewards the faith of a Canaanite woman, emphasizing the power of faith.
Jesus heals a blind man named Bartimaeus because of his faith, paralleling the role of faith in healing.
Jesus heals a blind man and tells him that his faith has saved him, showing the connection between faith and miracles.
